name: FreshRank – Instant Feedback for Better Content
author: Themeisle

sections.description:
FreshRank provides powerful AI-driven content analysis to help you optimize your websites’ content for both traditional search engines and AI platforms.

Stop guessing what’s wrong with your content. Analyze your WordPress posts, and FreshRank will analyze deliver actionable insights that improve user experience, engagement, and rankings.

Features

✅ AI-Powered Analysis
* Analyze content with GPT-5 Flagship model
* User experience focused
* Checks your content for factual errors and outdated information
* Growth opportunities assessment
* Search optimization recommendations
* AI platform visibility optimization

✒️ AI-assisted Draft Generation
* Use AI to fix the most important factual issues
* Full approval workflow
* Review every change, make additional edits and approve only what meets your standards

🔒 Security & Privacy
* Your content stays on your server
* No data sent to third parties (except OpenAI for analysis)

What FreshRank Analyzes

Get detailed insights across five categories that directly impact your content’s success.

  • Factual Updates – Outdated statistics, references to old software versions, information that may have changed due to recent events, and expired links.
  • User Experience – Content structure problems, readability issues, missing calls-to-action, formatting that hinders comprehension, and mobile usability concerns.
  • Growth Opportunities – Topics to expand, related content to add, multimedia opportunities, content gaps versus competitors, and emerging trends to cover.
  • Search Optimization – Meta descriptions, title tags, keyword optimization, internal linking, image alt text, and technical SEO factors affecting your rankings.
  • AI Visibility – How well AI platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity can understand and cite your content, including structured data, clear answers, and contextual information.

All issues are categorized by priority: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW

What’s Not Included in the Free Version

The free version includes full analysis capabilities but does not include:
– ❌ Multiple OpenAI model selection
– ❌ OpenRouter integration (450+ additional models)
– ❌ Separate models for analysis vs. writing
– ❌ Prioritization using Search Console data
– ❌ Fixes for all five issue categories
– ❌ Ability to use web search for the most accurate fact-checking
– ❌ Custom instructions to AI for analysis and draft creation
– ❌ Bulk actions
– ❌ Performance tracking

Want these features? Upgrade to FreshRank AI Pro

How It Works

  1. Connect – Add your OpenAI API key
  2. Analyze – Get comprehensive content analysis
  3. Review – See detailed recommendations
  4. Update – Fix the most critical factual issues automatically
  5. Review, Edit and Approve – Review updated content, make edits and replace old post

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • OpenAI API key (get free trial credits at platform.openai.com)

Thanks to Our Early Supporters

  • Bogdan Sandu | Design Your Way
  • Steven | Quants Note
  • Ahoi.dev
  • Accelera (accelerawp.com)

Support

  • Documentation: https://docs.themeisle.com/collection/2368-freshrank

External services

This plugin uses OpenAI and OpenRouter APIs to analyze and generate content. It only sends content you select to analyze and generate drafts.

sections.installation:
Activating the FreshRank plugin is just like any other plugin.

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. In the Search field type “FreshRank”
  3. Under “FreshRank” click the Install Now link
  4. Once the process is complete, click the Activate Plugin link
  5. Now, you’re able to use FreshRank and set up your OpenAI API key. The settings can be found under FreshRank AI > Settings.
sections.faq:
Does it work in other languages besides English?

Yes! FreshRank works in any language that GPT-5 supports. That includes 50+ languages like Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, and many more. The AI analyzes and generates drafts in your content’s original language.

Do I need my own API keys?

Yes, FreshRank uses your own OpenAI API key. This gives you full control and transparency. We provide detailed setup guides and cost estimation tools in the dashboard.

Does the plugin store my content on external servers?

Your content is temporarily sent to OpenAI’s API for analysis and updates, but FreshRank doesn’t permanently store your content on external servers.

All your articles, drafts, and analysis results are stored securely in your WordPress database on your own server. When you enable Google Search Console integration, only performance metrics are retrieved—not your content.

Your API keys are also stored securely in your WordPress database and never shared with third parties.
